posts.title: A Full Run-Down of Amazon Prime Membership Costs and Benefits
posts.excerpt: Alicia’s Deals may receive a commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
posts.text:
Alicia’s Deals may receive a commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
Amazon Prime Day is coming up July 8th-11th, and everyone is talking about Prime. The question is, is the membership worth the money to YOU?
First, let's talk cost. For the average person, the price of Prime is $139/year or $14.99/month (which works out to $179.88/year if you use all 12 months). You can head over here to get a free 30-day trial if you want to try it out. For 18 to 24-year-old young adults and students, Amazon is offering a free 6-month trial of Prime. Head over here to sign up (after the trial is up, you'll pay $7.49/month or $69/year). Young adults/students receive all of the benefits of Prime PLUS 5% cash back on purchases (10% on Prime Day). For EBT/Medicaid cardholders, Amazon offers 50% off a Prime membership ($6.99/month). Head over here for all of the details and qualifications for this program.
Second, let's talk about benefits. There's a whole lot more to Prime than just free shipping. The membership benefits I use all the time are free Prime Delivery (same-day to two-day shipping on almost everything determined on availability), Prime Video (I've found lots of series that I've enjoyed with my husband), Amazon Prime Music (over 100 million free songs and podcasts. NOTE: I DO NOT go for Amazon Music Unlimited for $10.99/month when my Alexa asks), Amazon Fresh (convenient fresh grocery delivery, I love that they often offer promo codes for extra $$ off), Amazon Prime Visa (5% cash back on Amazon purchases, 7% on Prime Days, plus they have a $200 bonus for getting a card this week), Prime Reading (free books I can read on my Kindle app), and Amazon First Reads books of the month (brand new titles that are always fun to read). I've used Prime Prescription Savings in the past, and it saved me a TON of $ off a prescription. For my family, the $11.58/month we spend on Prime (we pay the $139 annual fee in one payment) is well worth it.
If you're already paying for Prime, Amazon has put together a full list of included benefits. I highly recommend you check out this list and take advantage of everything you can:
"Delivery
FREE Two-Day Delivery: Millions of items delivered fast and free.
FREE One-Day Delivery: Available on more than 15 million items with no minimum purchase.
FREE Same-Day Delivery in eligible Zip Codes, on over 3 million items for qualifying orders that meet the minimum threshold of eligible items. For more information, go to Order with Prime FREE Same-Day Delivery.
Ultrafast Grocery Delivery: Get same day delivery on a wide selection of groceries, including meat, seafood, produce, snacks and household essentials. Prime members also have exclusive access to unlimited free delivery for $9.99 a month on orders $35+. Check availability in your area.
Free Grubhub+: Enjoy unlimited $0 food delivery fees, exclusive savings, and more with a free Grubhub+ membership.
Amazon Key: Get your packages conveniently delivered inside your garage. Check your eligibility.
FREE Release-Date Delivery: Be among the first to get new video games, books, music, movies and more. Choose Release-Date Delivery on qualified items and receive your package by 7 p.m. on that date. For more information, go to Release-Date Delivery.
FREE No-Rush Shipping: Don't need your Prime order right away? Select No-Rush Shipping and earn rewards for future purchases.
Amazon Day: Pick a day that works for you, and we'll deliver your weekly orders together on the day that you choose.
Streaming and Digital Benefits
On Prime Video, customers can find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports. Customers can also go behind the scenes of their favorite movies and series with exclusive X-Ray access. For more information, visit amazon.com/primevideo.
Alexa+ is an all-new version of Alexa powered by generative AI. It builds on the core Alexa experience, enhancing the functionality of Alexa features while introducing new Alexa+ specific capabilities. Alexa+ will be a free Prime benefit, at no additional cost, once Alexa+ Early Access ends.
Amazon Music included with Prime at no additional cost: music and top podcasts ad-free. Discover new music and podcasts based on your likes and access the largest catalog of ad-free top podcasts. For more information, go to amazon.com/music
Amazon Music Unlimited: 100 million songs on-demand and the most ad-free top podcasts. Listen offline and in HD audio—starting at $10.99/month with Prime.
Prime Gaming: Free games and a free monthly Twitch subscription included with your Amazon Prime membership.
Amazon Photos: unlimited full-resolution photo storage and 5GB for video storage with Amazon Photos.
Amazon Kids+: All-in-one subscription that gives kids access to thousands of kid-friendly books, movies, educational apps and games on compatible devices. Prime members get up to a 40% discount.
Shopping
At Amazon Fresh, Prime members can save up to 50% on grocery favorites and shop Prime Exclusive deals. At WholeFoods Market, Prime members can save on specific days of the week and get exclusive discounts. Shop in-store, pickup, or enjoy same-day delivery on a wide selection of groceries and household essentials. Eligible Prime members can earn a 5% cash back on groceries with a Prime Visa card.
Prime Day: Exclusive shopping event for Prime members delivering incredible savings and deep discounts on deals across every category.
Prime Exclusive Deals: Enjoy deals every day on thousands of items available only to Prime members.
Prime Visa: Earn 5% back at Amazon.com, Amazon Fresh, Whole Foods Market, and on Chase Travel. Earn at least 1% back on all other purchases. In addition, earn 10% back or more on select products as a limited time offer.
Prime Store Card: Earn 5% back every day on Amazon.com purchases and access exclusive promotional financing offers. In addition, earn 5-15% back on select rotating items throughout the year.
Amazon Prime Secured Card: Build your credit while earning 2% back on Amazon.com, Amazon Fresh and more.
Prime Early Access: Get 30-minute Early Access to Lightning Deals on Amazon.com.
Prime-Exclusive Shipping Benefits on Woot!: Prime members get free Standard Shipping on all Woot orders and free express shipping on Shirt.Woot purchases.
Buy with Prime: Fast, free delivery, and easy returns by shopping directly at participating online stores beyond Amazon.
Reading
Prime Reading: Read as much as you want from a selection of eBooks, magazines, and audiobooks, including single-sitting reads from Amazon Original Stories.
Amazon First Reads: Access an editorially curated selection of new books one month before they officially publish. Every month, Prime members can choose one Kindle book from our editors’ picks for free — $1.99 for non-Prime members. Downloaded titles are yours to keep.
Books with Audible Narration: Available through the free Kindle app and Audible’s free listening app on smartphones, tablets, and Alexa devices.
Medical Care and Prescription benefits
RxPass: Get your eligible medications for just $5 a month, no matter how many prescriptions you have.
One Medical: Get a care team on call for everyday health concerns and more. Only $9/mo for Prime members and $6/mo for each additional family member (up to six total members).
Prescription Delivery and Savings: Enjoy fast, FREE Two-Day Shipping on prescriptions from Amazon Pharmacy, plus exclusive savings when paying without insurance.
Save on Prescriptions: Search, compare and save up to 80% on prescriptions at over 60,000 pharmacies, including Amazon Pharmacy.
Other Benefits
Share Your Prime Benefits: Link your account with one other adult to share shipping, Prime Video, Prime Reading, and more for free. Members of Prime for Young Adults can’t share their Prime benefits.
Amazon Prime Fuel Savings: Save 10¢ a gallon at over 7,500 bp, Amoco, and ampm gas stations across the U.S." NOTE: I could not find a participating station in AZ, sadly. Please let me know if you find one!
If you decide the membership is not worth the money for you and your family, you can head over here to Amazon's Customer Service page to cancel and let them know!
I always shop around for every purchase I make. Amazon is NOT always the best deal (but they are a lot of the time)!
I hope this helps you decide if Prime is right for you!
Enjoy!

posts.title: SMART Target Money and Time Saving Hack That Just Saved Me $35! Remember This EVERY TIME You Shop!
posts.excerpt: Alicia’s Deals may receive a commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
posts.text:
Alicia’s Deals may receive a commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
If you shop at Target regularly you already know it's not always the cheapest store. Sometimes it IS the most convenient. I haven't taken advantage of Target's price match guarantee in quite a while and just had a personal experience with it that's a great reminder for all of us. Head over here to check out the guarantee rules. In a nutshell, they'll match the price of identical, in-stock objects sold by Amazon, Walmart, or Target.com (no third parties). If you're buying something big, you might as well double-check competitor prices on your phone (it will take ten seconds). This could save you big bucks on holiday gifts!
Yesterday, my daughter could not find her TI-84 calculator anywhere. She had calculus homework due and needed one immediately so I went on a shopping mission. Target had the calculator in stock but it was $149.99 (they're so much less expensive at back-to-school time...ugh). The exact same calculator was in stock at Amazon for $114.42. I showed guest services the link and got the price matched (and my daughter didn't have to wait for her calculator to be delivered by Amazon). The Target associate went through the entire price match guarantee with me (another employee came over to learn) and the most interesting part was that she fully admitted prices are often different at Target stores and on Target.com.
If you have a calculator emergency or just want one-stop shopping, this will save you time and sanity (it would have bugged me so much to pay full price)!
Enjoy!

The "Waltz of the Snowflakes" floats weightlessly above the angelic voices, whereas the "Dance of the Sugarplum Fairy" tiptoes to the haunting, music-box chimes of a celesta. A medley of exotic national dances—including a Spanish bolero and Russian Trepak—add to the phantasmagoric celebration before the whole dream ends, as all dreams must.

posts.title: Free Fishing Day is This Saturday, June 4th in Arizona!
posts.excerpt: If you've ever had any desire to fish, Saturday, June 4th is the perfect day to give it a try. It's free fishing day in AZ (you won't need a license)!
posts.text:
If you've ever had any desire to fish, Saturday, June 4th is the perfect day to give it a try. It's free fishing day in AZ (you won't need a license)!
Check out more information on their website:
"PHOENIX — The Arizona Game and Fish Department (AZGFD) invites anglers to fish Arizona waters for free Saturday, June 4. It’s an ideal time to take the family out for some fun and relaxing outdoor recreation.
Fishing is already a bargain. Arizona fishing licenses start at just $37 for residents 18 and older. A combination hunt and fish license for youths (10-17) are only $5. Arizona’s Free Fishing Day is celebrated as part of National Fishing and Boating Week. As an incentive, a fishing license is not required Saturday for persons fishing any public waters in Arizona.
“Whether you’re a seasoned angler who wants to introduce a newcomer to the sport, or someone who’s always been interested but never took that next step, this is the perfect time to get outdoors and experience what fishing in Arizona is all about,” said Julie Carter, aquatic wildlife branch chief.
While a fishing license is not needed Saturday, bag limits and other fishing regulations still apply and must be observed on Free Fishing Day. Children under 10 can fish for free all year long in Arizona, so this special fishing license exemption means that older kids and parents get a free pass for the day, as well.
Not sure how to fish and want to learn? Check out AZGFD’s learn to fish video series. Then, once you’re hooked, remember to purchase a fishing license.
The purchase of a fishing license directly contributes to state conservation programs, including fisheries management, habitat protection and fishing education. A portion of all fishing and boating supplies, as well as license and registration sales, fund the conservation and preservation of our nation’s waterways through a program called the Sport Fish Restoration Program. This means every time an angler purchases a fishing license, fishing tackle, boat supplies, or registers a boat, that person is helping to improve the natural places that he or she cherishes.
Anglers can also share their fishing success stories and photos to the AZGFD FishAZ Facebook group, as well as connect with other anglers around the state. "
Enjoy!

posts.text:
If you're on the west side of town, life could get a whole lot sweeter this weekend. Head to the grand opening of the newest Creamistry, located at 1235 N. 98th Avenue in Park West. From 12-2 PM Saturday, September 18th, they are offering free ice cream to all.
Check out the press release they sent over:
"Creamistry, the liquid nitrogen sweet shop that creates custom frozen desserts before guests’ eyes, is celebrating the grand opening of its latest location with a free small ice cream for each guest from noon to 2:00 p.m. on Saturday, September 18. Located at 1235 North 98th Avenue in Park West, Peoria’s premier dining and entertainment center located, this is Creamistry’s first West Valley store.
Former Arizona Cardinal player Andre Wadsworth and real estate professional Ryan Zeleznak, who co-own and operate Arizona’s Creamistry locations, selected Park West for their latest location as they feel it meets a need for fresh, custom ice cream creations in the West Valley.
“With each new Creamistry we open, we look for a dynamic, highly populated and energetic location, which we’ve found in Park West,” says Wadsworth. “We look forward to becoming a part of the West Valley community’s celebrations and everyday occasions for years to come.”
Creamistry uses high-quality premium ingredients with more than 20 flavors and a wide variety of topping options including natural and organic selections such as non-dairy water-based sorbet and gluten-free, egg-free vegan coconut and cashew. Flavor choices include Cap’N Crunch, Fruity Pebbles, Birthday Cake, Cookie Butter, Matcha Green Tea, Reese’s Peanut Butter, Ruby Cacao, Taro and Nutella as well as classics such as Caramel, Chocolate, Madagascar Vanilla Bean, Mint, Sea Salt Caramel and Strawberry.
Toppings and upgrades include mini gummy bears, mini marshmallows, Heath bar, Reese’s Peanut Butter Cups, freshly baked brownie bites, cookie dough bites, cheesecake bites, “unicorn dust,” fresh fruits and nuts, sauces such as caramel, chocolate fudge and strawberry sundae and savory items like candied bacon, chamoy and Tajin. Signature creations, premium ice cream cakes and grab-and-go items round out the selections at Creamistry.
Strategically located in front of the open-air shopping center’s splash pad, the new Creamistry store offers families, shoppers and ice cream lovers of all ages the same fresh and innovative made-to-order liquid-nitrogen ice cream creations as the other Creamistry locations in the Valley of the Sun — including one in North Scottsdale and one in Gilbert.
Creamistry Park West is open daily from noon to 9:00 p.m. For more, visit www.creamistry.com."
Thanks Charlotte and Susie!
Enjoy!

Once an esteemed doctor at the vanguard of electroshock therapy for the mentally insane, the physician let his psychiatric hospital become a madhouse, prompting rumors of Vantas using inhumane experiments on patients. ZooLights

Meanwhile, guests can take photos with Santa while also experiencing a simulated snowfall every night.
Dinosaurs in the Desert will be open during ZooLights and features lifelike animatronic dinosaurs, a fossil dig for kids, photo ops, and more. Additional fees apply.

Benefits
This machine is designed to create smooth, uniform curls without the strain and fuss of twisting a traditional curling iron.
How It Works
Hair is drawn into a ceramic curl chamber, where it’s coiled and heated up until each curl is set. Users can choose to release the hair on their own or opt for a pre-set timer that beeps when it’s time to set hair free after creating a loose wave, soft curl, or more-defined curl.
How to Use It
Start by lightly misting your hair with hairspray and making sure it’s combed through and tangle-free. Choose a one-inch section of hair and position the ends at the open mouth of the curl chamber. When you close the chamber, the machine will automatically draw your hair inside, and if you choose a timer setting, it will beep to let you know when the curl is ready.

Kinsa’s team of top engineers have implemented the latest technology in machine learning and data science to ensure you are always getting the most accurate and efficient reading possible—and one that continues to improve with every app update.
Kinsa also detects if your thermometer isn’t in an ideal position, helping you settle back in place for a more accurate reading.
Kinsa is thin and flexible, making it not only more comfortable, but also the most unbreakable thermometer on the market for all ages. Kids love Kinsa’s bubble popping game, bright colors, and simple, visual symptom options so much that they don’t only stay put for readings, they ask for Kinsa again and again.
10 second average read time
Exceeds both ASTM and ISO standards for professional accuracy

posts.title: Chipotle Cultivate Festival is This Saturday! Free Festival With Music, Chef Demonstrations, and More! Earn a Free Burrito!
posts.excerpt: The Chipotle Cultivate festival is coming to town this Saturday, April 30th at Westworld. Admission is free as are all of the musical acts and activities!…
posts.text:
The Chipotle Cultivate festival is coming to town this Saturday, April 30th at Westworld. Admission is free as are all of the musical acts and activities! Parking is $5 and you can earn a free burrito when you participate in interactive food experiences with their passport!
Check out the info about the freebie: "Visit the five experiences around the festival, learn from what they have to offer, and get your program stamped. Once you’ve completed at least three, bring your program to the Info Tent and you’ll receive a coupon for a FREE burrito, bowl, salad or order of tacos and IZZE at any Chipotle."
Check out a little bit more information about the event:
"Cultivate Phoenix encourages attendees to think and talk about food and food issues, as well as how to create a more sustainable future. While many festival-goers come for the entertainment, the free festival also offers interactive experiences for all ages to learn something new about how food is raised and prepared.
At the festival, renowned chefs from Phoenix and around the country will offer cooking demonstrations and seminars. Additionally, six national musical acts will perform throughout the day, including Young the Giant, Echosmith, Lukas Graham, Betty Who, Holychild and Jared & The Mill.
The high-profile chefs involved with Cultivate Phoenix are working to make positive changes in the nation’s food supply. Participating in Cultivate Phoenix allows these chefs to bring awareness to the public while demonstrating the impact food has on society and the importance of food that is raised right. The lineup of featured chefs includes Aaron Sanchez (Chef/Partner at Johnny Sanchez in New Orleans and Baltimore, host of Cooking Channel’s Taco Trip, and judge on Food Network’s “Chopped”); Amanda Freitag (co-host of Food Network’s “American Diner Revival,” judge on “Chopped,” and author of “The Chef Next Door”); Chris Bianco (Pizzeria Bianco in Phoenix and Tucson, and Pane Bianco in Phoenix); Stephen Jones (the larder + the delta); and Charleen Badman (FnB Restaurant) with Pavle Milic (FnB Restaurant, Los Milics Wine).
Chipotle will be serving up burritos, tacos and menu items from ShopHouse Southeast Asian Kitchen, Chipotle’s Asian concept. Each dish will be made using fresh, responsibly grown ingredients.
The festival will have an Artisans’ Hall featuring local artisanal desserts and sweet treats for purchase. Wine, beer and hard cider from local Phoenix breweries and wineries will be available for those 21 and older to purchase at the Tasting Hall. Chipotle has also partnered with three nationally acclaimed breweries, including Phoenix-based Arizona Wilderness to create a “Cultivate Mexican Lager” brewed exclusively for the three 2016 Cultivate festivals in Phoenix, Kansas City and Miami.
Cultivate Phoenix includes interactive experiences focused on sustainable food, and a Kids’ Zone with activities and snacks for the entire family. The experiences will allow attendees to explore the importance of animal welfare; issues surrounding genetically modified foods, or GMOs; the secret to making Chipotle’s famous guacamole; the reality of processed foods; and best practices for preparing food safely.
For more information, please visit: Chipotle.com/Cultivate"
Thanks Libby!
Enjoy!

Do you want to get away to the White Mountains this fall? Head over here to get two nights at the highly rated PVC at the Roundhouse Resort for $143.20 Sunday-Wednesday or $175.20 Thursday-Saturday with promo code LABORDAY20 (20% off any Living Social Deal), usually $334. Check out their reviews on Trip Advisor!
The deal is good for stays through November 26th.
More info...
"The Destination
Far from the cacti-dotted deserts of southern Arizona, the White Mountains in the state's northern region are known for their blushing sandstone cliffs, ponderosa pines, and abundance of year-round outdoor activities. In Pinetop, less than 200 miles east of Phoenix, hiking and mountain biking trails are plentiful among the rolling hills and quiet groves: The White Mountain Trail System offers 200 miles of protected pathways, and the Apache-Sitgreaves National Forest beckons to adventurers with more than 2.76 million acres of unspoiled wilds.
The Digs
In a cozy, all-seasons hideaway at an elevation of 7,200 feet, there's no better spot than PVC at the Roundhouse Resort to frolic in the fresh air. Situated between the Apache and Sitgreaves National Forests and the unspoiled lands of the White Mountain Apache Reservation, you'll have access to the neighboring resort's recreation center and its heated indoor pool, exercise equipment, ping-pong table, and pool tables—not to mention the on-site playground with mini golf course. Your cheery cabin features bright décor and warm woods, plus two full bathrooms, air conditioning, a washer and dryer, fully equipped kitchen, and Internet access. Kick back in front of the electric fireplace, zone out in the private whirlpool-jet tub, and watch the sun set from the covered porch—when nature is this close, you won't want to miss a minute of it."
Enjoy!
